name: GFxF
source:
After joining a small club devoted to discussing the ups and downs of yuri in fiction, shy college student Mona finds herself a reluctant spectator of a clash between two titans. In one corner, the fiery and tempestuous Riley. In the other, the passionate and steadfast Hana. 

The two juggernauts of the yuri fandom collide over magical girls, idols, directorial framing, capitalism, target audience, and the military-industrial complex...? How the heck did we get there...?

[From [url=https://punishedhag.itch.io/gfxf]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
害羞的大学生莫娜加入了一个讨论虚构作品中百合表现优劣的小社团，却不情不愿地成了两位巨头交锋的观众。一边是脾气火爆、喜怒无常的莱莉，另一边则是热情坚定的哈娜。

两位百合圈巨头，从魔法少女、偶像、导演的镜头语言、资本主义、目标受众，一路争论到军工复合体……？到底是怎么聊到这里的……？

[摘自[url=https://punishedhag.itch.io/gfxf]Itch.io[/url]]
